Question:
One diagonal of a rectangle has length \(10\). How long is the other diagonal? (Enter only the number.)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_186_q1_question_en.svg)
Solution: The diagonals of a rectangle are equal in length, so the other diagonal also has length \(10\).
